description.value: Island Poké is a Hawaiian-style poke bowl restaurant in downtown Victoria offering both chef-designed signature bowls and a fully customizable build-your-own option with fresh fish, tofu, and a wide range of toppings and sauces. With two Victoria-area locations and online ordering for pickup or delivery, it caters to both dine-in and on-the-go customers. For touring cyclists passing through the city centre, it offers a quick, protein-rich, customizable meal on Douglas Street.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: bollard (2 spaces, covered) at 85m; bollard (2 spaces, covered) at 95m; rack (6 spaces) at 95m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active restaurant at 1674 Douglas Street, Victoria with pickup, delivery, and dine-in ordering. The menu explicitly lists a vegetarian EARTH bowl (organic tofu, chickpea, vegetables) and 'GLUTEN FREE SOY SAUCE' as a dressing option. No bike parking, washroom, or water refill information is mentioned anywhere on the website; OSM also carries no such tags.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; 250-590-0801 taken from website for the Downtown location.
